title: Why you think everyone noticed your mistake

scenes.say: You think everyone noticed. Most didn't.
It's called the spotlight effect. Your moment feels huge, so you assume everyone is watching it too.
One explanation: you start from your own feelings and don't adjust enough for everyone else.
In one Cornell study, students wore an embarrassing T-shirt into a room. They guessed about half would notice. Only 23 percent did.
Like a typo in the family WhatsApp group. You cringe all evening. Others are probably busy with their own day.
